    mm = 0
    ss = 0
    pm = 0
    out = []
    for row in vectors:
        if row.get('reset'):
            hh, mm, ss, pm = 12, 0, 0, 0
        elif row.get('ena'):
            ss += 1
            if ss == 60:
                ss = 0
                mm += 1
                if mm == 60:
                    mm = 0
                    hh += 1
                    if hh == 13:
                        hh = 1
                        pm ^= 1
                    elif hh == 12:
                        pm ^= 1
        out.append({'pm': pm, 'hh': ((hh // 10) << 4) | (hh % 10),
                    'mm': ((mm // 10) << 4) | (mm % 10),
                    'ss': ((ss // 10) << 4) | (ss % 10)})
        if 'mid' in row:
            m = row['mid']
            if m.get('reset'):
                hh, mm, ss, pm = 12, 0, 0, 0
            elif m.get('ena'):
                ss += 1
                if ss == 60:
                    ss = 0
                    mm += 1
                    if mm == 60:
                        mm = 0
                        hh += 1
                        if hh == 13:
                            hh = 1
                            pm ^= 1
                        elif hh == 12:
                            pm ^= 1
    return out
